</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This prevents them from accessing critical policyholder documents and performing essential claims tasks.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Five accounts have reported this issue via support [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n- Linnet House Insurance, with an ARR of 360000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:8816911502d203bd].\n- Tidewell Marine & Cargo, with an ARR of 420000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4].\n- Merrow Vale Motor, with an ARR of 46000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a].\n- Brackwater Homecover, with an ARR of 610000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:b454c97be44913b5].\n- Marrowgate Commercial, with an ARR of 1600000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been seven mentions of this problem across one route [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n- All seven mentions came through the support route [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n- A user from Linnet House Insurance stated, I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you guide me through it? [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49].\n- A user from Tidewell Marine & Cargo stated, I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4].\n- A user from Merrow Vale Motor stated, I’m locked out of our claims portal and need to reset my password urgently [i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a].\n- A user from Brackwater Homecover stated, I need to reset my password because I’m locked out of the claims dashboard and can’t access policyholder documents [i:b454c97be44913b5].\n- A user from Marrowgate Commercial stated, I need to reset my password for accessing the claims portal — can you guide me through that? [i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n- The total ARR of the affected accounts is 3036000.0 GBP [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n\n## Why now\n- One renewal is due within the next 90 days, for Marrowgate Commercial on 2026-12-12 [i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n- The problem has been reported consistently from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-25 [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].\n- The issue blocks access to time-sensitive claims tasks and documents, creating urgency for users who need immediate portal access [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5].",
